jobs.title: Project Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Excel Fluid Group

Project Solutions Engineer

This is a fulltime first shift position (Monday – Friday) 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM

Position Overview

The Project Solutions Engineer serves as an in-house engineering resource for the Business Development and Project Sales teams, with a focus on reviewing opportunities early, strengthening technical recommendations, and helping move qualified projects from initial review to a clearly scoped, specifiable solution. This role is intended to provide practical engineering judgment, support customer-facing technical credibility, and help give the buyer or specifying engineer confidence in EFG’s design recommendations.

The position supports the BD team by reviewing project information as opportunities come in, commenting on design considerations, identifying risks or gaps, and helping determine whether EFG’s recommended solution is technically appropriate. The role should keep the BD team involved in the customer relationship while reducing the time spent on detailed technical review, design interpretation, and engineering coordination.

For candidates with Professional Engineer licensure, this role may include responsible review and stamping of applicable project work once the individual has developed sufficient familiarity with EFG’s process, standards, products, and internal controls. Use of a professional stamp must be based on sound engineering judgment, proper review, and comfort with the scope of responsibility.

Responsibilities

Duties would include but not limited to:

Review specifications, drawings, and project data early in the opportunity process to evaluate feasibility, application fit, and technical risk.
Provide practical design comments and engineering recommendations that support BD discussions with buyers, engineers, and project stakeholders.
Help translate customer needs, site conditions, and project requirements into technically sound, cost-conscious system solutions.
Assess hydraulic, civil, electrical, structural, and site-specific considerations to identify concerns before proposals or recommendations are finalized.
Prepare early-stage documentation, including technical summaries, design assumptions, equipment recommendations, review notes, and preliminary layouts.
Prepare design reports, engineering review packages, and supporting documentation for review by external engineers or other qualified reviewers.
Participate in client calls, site visits, pre-bid discussions, and engineer-facing conversations when technical credibility or clarification is needed.
Collaborate with Business Development, Project Sales, internal engineering resources, and external subject matter experts to refine defensible system designs, proposal strategy, and project handoff.
Support responsible engineering review of applicable project work, including stamped work where appropriate based on licensure, review standards, and scope of responsibility.
Maintain current knowledge of EFG products, component manufacturers, industry standards, and application best practices.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related engineering discipline required.
Active Professional Engineer license required or strongly preferred; Civil PE or PE with directly relevant water/wastewater, municipal infrastructure, pump station, or site development experience preferred.
5+ years of relevant experience in civil, water/wastewater, pump station, utility, or infrastructure-related engineering preferred.
Demonstrated ability to review plans, specifications, submittals, and project requirements and provide practical engineering recommendations.
Comfortable working directly with Business Development and Sales teams in a fast-moving opportunity environment.
Ability and willingness, where properly licensed and supported by adequate review, to take professional responsibility for applicable engineering work.
Solid understanding of pumps, hydraulics, site layout considerations, and project design coordination.
Excellent technical writing, communication, and judgment skills.

Resume and/or Cover Letter

Additional Notes

Limitations and Disclaimer

All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State Laws.

Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Population Health Management
jobs.description:
Overview

Reporting to the SVP for Population and Community Health, this position works collaboratively across teams to develop and maintain data collection, measurement tools and databases to support data analysis in support of population health, community health and managed care initiatives.

As part of the ongoing work of One Brooklyn Health to transform healthcare delivery in Central Brooklyn, the Population and Community Health team works to eliminate racial and gender health inequities rooted in historical and contemporary injustices, by improving health outcomes, addressing social drivers and using data for advocacy.

Responsibilities

Designing and building population health data set processes for purposes such as modeling, production or mining.
Performing and interpreting population health data studies to learn more about new data sources or new uses for existing ones.
Develop reports, dashboards, scorecards, and other analytics results as necessary to support activities related to population health and other strategic goals.
Analyze, interpret and generate reports on performance related to overall outcomes, utilization, risk adjusted total costs of care, population health and care coordination.
Support the analysis of data from multiple sources, primarily claims files associated with value-based contracts.
Provide insight for informed decision-making and planning by identifying trends/patterns within complex data sets and visualizing and deploying the data to appropriately inform stakeholders.
Develop innovative recommendations to achieve successes related to population health management initiatives and impact quality and efficiency in the delivery model, resulting in a positive impact to clinical and financial outcomes.
Serve as subject matter expert to support the population health needs regarding claims data, value-based contracts, and quality data.
Develop and maintain quality control standards and data reconciliation techniques for internal and external reporting.
Create and maintain documentation relating to data management including training guides, report specifications, and data dictionaries.
Adhere to reporting deadlines for assigned reports.

Qualifications

Position Requirements:

Bachelor's Degree BA/BS in computer science, statistics, and/or public health or related field (required).
Master's Degree Master’s in Business, Health Administration, Finance or other preferred.
5 years Minimum of five (5) to ten (10) years of experience working with data visualization software such as Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, etc. preferred.
3 years Minimum of three (3) to five (5) years of experience working with statistical programming languages such as R or Python (Preferred) Knowledge of CMS, TJC and other applicable regulations.
Fluent in MS Office, including MS Excel and MS PowerPoint.
Experience with EPIC Reporting.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong conceptual analytical and quantitative skills.
Strong data collection, manipulation, and analysis skills.
An informed perspective on embedding and applying a racial and gender justice lens in decision-making, planning and implementation.
Familiarity with SQL programming language concepts
Experience with health insurance claims structure and analytics, including GPRO/HEDIS Quality measures, risk adjustment methodologies, efficiency of care and utilization metrics.
Experience with large data sets, clinical quality measures, and claims analysis. Experience with data sets typically found in a health plan environment, including claims data, care management and care planning data, provider network management data, etc.
Intermediate to Advanced level knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite including Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Advanced skills in Excel and ease with data management concepts (i.e. MS Access, SQL). Skill in oral and written communication and time management with ability to effectively present to and facilitate groups
Experience presenting technical data and information to non-technical users.
Working knowledge of finance, accounting, financial models, healthcare data, market and competitive analysis techniques
Interest in and active pursuit of opportunities to learn and grow, and ability to handle multiple demands, shifting priorities, crises, and rapid change.

The salary range and/or hourly rate listed is a good faith determination of potential base compensation that may be offered to a successful applicant for this position at the time of this job advertisement and can be modified in the future. When determining a team member’s base salary and/or rate, several factors may be considered as applicable (e.g., site, specialty, service line, years of relevant experience, education, credentials, negotiated contracts, budget and internal equity).

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of One Brooklyn Health (OBH).

OBH is an equal opportunity employer, it is our policy to provide equal opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, marital status, military status, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability or handicap or other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems LLC is looking for an enthusiastic, well-qualified individual to fill the Data Analyst position. This role offers the opportunity to work with a diverse and talented group of individuals committed to driving success.

The ideal candidate is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and managing system and project data to support Tech Refresh operations, data-driven decision-making, and process improvement initiatives.

The Data Analyst provides actionable insights, automation recommendations, and project status reporting to support current and future growth. This position plays a key role in ensuring Tech Refresh schedules, asset execution, and implementation activities are supported by accurate, timely, and well-structured data.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst will

Support Tech Refresh data analysis activities across DIA systems and sites within contract scope
Collect, analyze, and maintain system, asset, and project data related to Tech Refresh operations
Provide process improvement and automation recommendations to enhance Tech Refresh execution and data management
Develop and maintain project data, dashboards, reports, and status updates to track schedule, implementation, and asset execution
Prepare and define data requirements supporting Tech Refresh utilization, planning, and execution
Analyze trends and performance metrics to support project success and future enterprise growth
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting artifacts
Collaborate with technical, operational, and leadership teams to translate requirements into data-driven solutions
Support planning and scalability efforts for future DIA and Defense Intelligence Enterprise sites
Document data sources, methodologies, and analytical processes

Skills And Experience

The Data Analyst must have

Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance
10+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, data management, data engineering, or related disciplines supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, or Federal programs
Demonstrated experience collecting, acquiring, extracting, integrating, inspecting, cleansing, validating, and managing data from multiple structured and unstructured sources
Strong knowledge of data analysis, data management principles, and data lifecycle processes
Experience or working knowledge of data engineering principles, data science methodologies, and process automation and optimization techniques
Proven ability to analyze complex datasets and translate findings into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) or Intelligence Community (IC) programs
Familiarity with enterprise IT modernization, technology refresh (Tech Refresh), or digital transformation initiatives
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple data sources, priorities, and deliverables in a dynamic environment

Education and Certifications

The Data Analyst must meet the following

Required

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
Relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree

Preferred

CompTIA Security+ CE
CompTIA Data+
Certified Data Analyst (vendor-neutral or platform-specific)
Microsoft, AWS, or other analytics-related certifications

Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
401(k)
PTO
Paid Parental Leave
Tuition reimbursement
Paid federal holidays

Security Clearance

Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of Defense active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

Company Summary

Headquartered in Hawaii, Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC, is an SBA-Certified NHO-owned 8(a) Small Business specializing in global information technology solutions. We deliver professional services in IT Design & Installation, Cybersecurity Engineering & Support, Application Integration & Development, Software & Hardware Engineering, Network & Systems Management, Information Systems Security, and Business Management Services.

Leveraging over 30 years of providing IT services to the federal & commercial market with projects found around the world, our team has innovative expertise in the development of a wide range of technological solutions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Our service commitment is simple - "Quality IT Solutions... On Time & On Budget."

Company Employment Statement

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing as positions, functions, and qualifications may vary depending on business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, color, creed, religion, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition), sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, or Vietnam era, or other eligible veteran status or legally protected characteristics.
